The nested-grid Doob bound supplies an integrable squared supremum; upward stopping-time rounding is adapted and right continuity plus dominated event integrals proves the stopped martingale identity without completion.

The title names the standard constancy principle, while the actual Statement explicitly restricts to zero initial value and integrable total variation. That precise claim is sound: the clipped derivative is bounded, the partition remainder tends to zero by uniform continuity, and R times total variation dominates the sums. Zero expectation of the nonnegative primitive forces fixed-time zero, then rational times and continuity give one full-measure equality event. Its exact all-time-zero event is measurable as {V_T(D)=0}, since D_0=0 and integrable total variation is a measurable random variable. No assertion removing the Statement hypotheses is used by this proof or page; no cosmetic edit is needed.

A1 incorrectly attributed an AC hypothesis to the simple-function density theorem, whose actual statement works on arbitrary measure spaces and makes no such assumption. Corrected A1 to inherit AC from the model contract and explicitly distinguish the choice-free simple-density interface. Tonelli gives finite mass E A_T, the time-zero slice is null, generator intersections form a pi-system, and indicator closure is a lambda-system by finite-measure L2 tail convergence. Refining the finitely many rectangle endpoints expresses their span as bounded predictable steps modulo the null time-zero slice. F4 then proves density without any stronger assumption.

Analysis of A and M remains on [0,T]: the bounded compensator and exponential residual survival calculation give the all-pairs martingale identity and square integrability. This repairs an example-domain defect, with no change to a Statement or Definition section.

F2 omitted B_0=0 and E B_T<infinity from the scalar bracket class and overstated uniqueness; adding a positive constant disproves that unrestricted wording. The theorem conclusion is valid: A already starts at zero and has integrable total variation. The stopped-grid square identity gives M^2-N as a martingale using deterministic bounds at each stopping level; the sampled Doob L2 bound and integrable N_T justify unstopping. Adding M proves M^2-A, and A satisfies both exact bracket interfaces. The theorem Statement is unchanged.
